_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F11, a rescue: the innkeeper goes home (the village inn).

text.zh_TW: 旅店老闆娘被綁在吧檯邊，還在罵人：「放開我！我的燉肉還在爐子上！」
text.en: The innkeeper is tied to a bar stool, still shouting. "Let me go! My stew is still on the stove!"

text.zh_TW: 老闆娘：「燒焦就重煮！里歐，回村後來旅店，我煮一大鍋給你——你最愛的。」
text.en: Innkeeper: "Then I'll cook another! Leo, come to the inn when you're back. A whole pot, just for you. Your favourite."
